description: This PHP class defines data transfer object (DTO) parameters for filtering attendance reports in the OrangeHRM system. It extends a date range filter and includes additional filtering options such as employee numbers, job title, subunit, and employment status.

classes.name: AttendanceReportSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying search filters in attendance report queries, including date range, employee numbers, job title, subunit, and employment status.

methods.name: getJobTitleId
methods.description: Returns the job title ID filter criterion.

methods.name: setJobTitleId
methods.description: Sets the job title ID filter criterion.

methods.name: getSubUnitId
methods.description: Returns the subunit ID filter criterion.

methods.name: setSubUnitId
methods.description: Sets the subunit ID filter criterion.

methods.name: getEmploymentStatusId
methods.description: Returns the employment status ID filter criterion.

methods.name: setEmploymentStatusId
methods.description: Sets the employment status ID filter criterion.

methods.name: getEmployeeNumbers
methods.description: Returns the list of employee numbers used in filtering.

methods.name: setEmployeeNumbers
methods.description: Sets the list of employee numbers for filtering.
